## Installation

You can install the latest version of **miroclimr** from Github using
the [`devtools`](https://github.com/r-lib/devtools) package:

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("devtools")

devtools::install_github("sylvainschmitt/miroclimr")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(miroclimr)
hobo
```

# Package index

## Data

Micro- and macro-climate data

- [`era`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/era.md)
  : ERA5-Land macroclimatic data for the Mormal forest
- [`hobo`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/hobo.md)
  : HOBO micrloclimatic data from the Mormal forest

## Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)

Functions for Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) of a series of temperatures

- [`fft_tab()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_tab.md)
  : Fourier table
- [`fft_roll()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_roll.md)
  : Fourier roll
- [`fft_ratio()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_ratio.md)
  : Fourier ratio

## Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) base

Base functions for Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) of a series of
temperatures

- [`fft_rfft()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_rfft.md)
  : Fourier coefficients
- [`fft_amplitude()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_amplitude.md)
  : FFT amplitude
- [`fft_phase()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_phase.md)
  : FFT phase
- [`fft_coefficient()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_coefficient.md)
  : FFT Rebuild coefficient
- [`fft_freq()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_freq.md)
  : FFT frequency
- [`fft_period()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_period.md)
  : FFT periods
- [`fft_mean()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_mean.md)
  : FFT mean
- [`fft_power()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_power.md)
  : FFT power
- [`fft_energy()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_energy.md)
  : FFT energy
- [`fft_variance()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_variance.md)
  : FFT variance
- [`fft_delay()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_delay.md)
  : FFT delay
- [`fft_reconstruct()`](https://sylvainschmitt.github.io/microclimr/reference/fft_reconstruct.md)
  : FFT reconstruct
